brand_message: 한 컵 안에, 재료가 머문 결.
launch_story_spine: Hero — 실제 음식의 차이를 한 컵에서 먼저 보여 준다
Why MORA — 토핑과 효능이 가리던 재료의 상태를 선택 기준으로 바꾼다
Origin — 확인되지 않은 창립자 전기 대신 무엇을 남길지라는 브랜드의 출발 질문을 공개한다
Measured Transformation — 배양·스트레이닝·재료 준비·저전단 폴딩·충전·밀봉·최종 검사의 인과를 보여 준다
Ingredient Library — 원재료마다 syrup, aqueous preparation, slurry, paste, oil phase라는 다른 중간 형태를 쓴다
One Base, Six Directions — herbal, green, toasted, bright, deep, savory를 동일 컵 구조로 비교한다
Clear Witness Experience — 투명 용기, 검정 직접 인쇄, foil 개봉, 한 번의 spoon trace로 제품을 이해한다
founder_story_rule: 실명, 연도, 장소, 경력, 최초 배치와 인용이 검증되지 않았으므로 공개본은 비전기적 brand origin으로 작성한다. 생성 maker는 founder로 캡션하지 않는다.
packaging_lock: minimal neutral-black direct print with MORA small and exact recipe name larger
flat full-perimeter peelable foil with asymmetric tab
no individual paper label, sleeve, collar, sticker, opaque backing or recipe-color ink
outer molded-fiber carrier is permitted only as an external multipack function
food, material, print and performance claims remain directional until physical validation

series_locks.product_fronts: six separate 1:1 strict-frontal portraits; same clear cup geometry, 0-degree azimuth, 15-18-degree elevation, pale-mineral set, baseline, occupancy, broad upper-left light, flat removed foil and spoon; exact recipe name and actual food trace only variables
series_locks.brand_mood_axes: same maker, charcoal wardrobe, modern stainless food workspace, direct-print sealed cup and hard-but-broad daylight; strict 0-degree front, exact 90-degree side and true 90-degree overhead aerial are separate files
series_locks.meta_story: raw ingredient, preparation base, intermediate and finished trace must remain causally adjacent; one tool and one changed state per frame; no perfume, spirits, apothecary or invented equipment

shot_plan.landing_job: hero-capable negative space and process system overview
clear cup, foil, spoon and outer carrier roles

image_claim_gates: Every generated photograph is a directional commercial-visualization, not evidence of an actual founder, facility, SOP or production run.
No image may imply validated food contact, barrier, freshness, leak-proof, sustainability, handmade, small-batch, nutritional, health or origin performance.
Fig Leaf remains safety- and regulation-gated; its frame may show a directional leaf-led preparation but cannot claim edible suitability.
No generated numeric readout, batch code, legal panel, barcode, date, duration, temperature, pH, dose or tolerance.
